caseName: Shakin v. Board of Medical Examiners of Cal.
caseNameFull: Shakin v. Board of Medical Examiners of California
attorneys: Burton Marks and Harvey A. Schneider for appellant.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
